# milestone-loc-tokens-ai-ledger

> Generates a self-hosted, static HTML dashboard tracking a project's lines of code, words, and LLM token cost per git milestone, with a dated, multi-source, editable price ledger.

Author: Fernando Teco Sodré. English only, no translations.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): operating protocol for an AI agent or assistant installing or running this skill on someone's behalf. Read this before installing it or running the engine.
- [README.md](README.md): what this skill delivers, the installation matrix, honest limits.
- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): the skill itself, the non-negotiable rule, how to run the engine. Also: the price ledger's fields, pricing several models and 1-hour cache writes, and correcting a wrong price with `--reprice`.

## Kit

- [engine/](engine/): the Python engine, standard library only.
- [template/](template/): the dashboard skeleton and its price panel.
- [logbook/](logbook/): this repository's own generated dashboard, proof this works.

## Origin

Part of the [Harness series and the MEDIR cycle](https://github.com/tecosodreaboutdigital/harness-medir): Map, Equip, Delegate, Inspect, Reinforce.
